plugins.name: cline使用与上游选择
plugins.description:
Expose ClinePass' real upstream choice.

Every chat request is logged with the provider that actually served it, how many fallbacks remained, the prompt-cache hit count and the exact cost. The model list ships 18 built-in cline-pass models with their context window and thinking levels; tick the ones you allow and anything else is rejected at forward time with 404 model_not_enabled. The ClinePass API key is sealed at rest with Windows DPAPI (bound to the current user) — only ciphertext touches disk, and it is decrypted into memory once at startup.

Note: the Cline gateway ignores client-side routing hints. provider.only and allow_fallbacks were tested with three different providers and the request still landed on the affinity-pinned upstream, so this plugin reports the real route instead of promising to pin it.

plugins.name: 任务看板
plugins.description:
一个只读任务看板：一屏看清谁在等你批计划或回答、谁在跑、有哪些待审批、谁刚跑完。侧栏四列 + 置顶浮窗两种形态，刷新按活跃度自适应，会话清单缓存复用。点行直达会话，双击唤起主窗。全程只读，不读正文、不写文件、不联网。
alt+space搜索任务看板，点击后可以呼出悬浮面板，默认置顶。

plugins.name: 侧边终端工具
plugins.description: PI-Desktop 工作面板里的内嵌终端：按项目隔离会话，支持 ⌘T 唤起、右键菜单和输入法自动切换。

plugins.name: UniPi
plugins.description:
Muse Desktop, adapted for PI-Desktop! UniPi is an unofficial port of the open-source Muse Desktop project, bringing its interface and themes to PI-Desktop with your configured models—no Muse Code CLI required. Includes conversation management, model switching, project file previews, read-only Git information, and replacement unicorn artwork.

Based on Muse Desktop by Robert Courson (@robzilla1738), with original attribution and MIT license preserved. Model tool execution, attachments, and microphone input are currently unavailable.

plugins.name: pi-desktop-open-tools
plugins.description: An entry point for launching external tools has been added below the project chat box; you can configure it to open tools such as VS Code, a terminal, etc.

plugins.name: Session Titles
plugins.description: Generate concise titles for new sessions with a configurable prompt, model, and thinking level.

plugins.name: Ubuntu Session Titles
plugins.description: Ubuntu-focused PI-Desktop session titles with Simplified Chinese defaults, configurable prompts and models, and protection for manual renames. An independent StrongHE fork of Lan’s Session Titles.

plugins.name: Agents Anywhere 远程助手
plugins.description: 基于 Agents Anywhere 平台实现手机端对 Pi Desktop 的远程查看、发问与控制。

plugins.name: 便签
plugins.description: Markdown 桌面便签：多便签管理、实时预览、任务列表勾选、荧光笔高亮与回收站。Sticky notes with Markdown preview, task lists, text highlights and recycle bin.

plugins.name: Cline Pass For Pi Desktop
plugins.description: 非常便宜的Cline Pass接入Pi-Desktop

plugins.name: Clipboard History
plugins.description: Capture clipboard text while PI-Desktop runs, keep 30 days of history, restore any entry with one click.

plugins.name: File Manager
plugins.description: Browse, view and edit the open project in the right work panel: a full directory tree with per-file-type icons, syntax-highlighted editing, a Markdown preview, image and media viewing, CSV/JSON structured views, read-only SQLite browsing with a SQL query box, a context menu for creating and renaming, and filename search.

plugins.name: Git Lens
plugins.description: GitLens-inspired local Git management for PI-Desktop: status, history, diff, blame, branches, commits and stashes. Docks in the right work panel (no separate window). Human UI only — no agent tools.

plugins.name: Goal X
plugins.description: Persistent workspace goals, task evidence, and host-owned completion audits for PI-Desktop.

plugins.name: Log Viewer
plugins.description: 大日志文件查看器：GB 级流式分页、虚拟滚动、实时跟随、搜索高亮、文本/等级过滤、钉住对比。Log viewer for huge files: paging, tail, search, filter, pin.

plugins.name: Pi-Desktop 机器人
plugins.description: 通过飞书、Telegram、微信等聊天工具接入 PI-Desktop Agent：发送任务、接收结果、回答问题和审阅计划。

plugins.name: Obsidian Theme
plugins.description: A deep blue-teal global theme tuned to a measured reference: surfaces lifted from #0F1B26 to #223648, hierarchy carried by 1px #2A4054 hairlines rather than glow, a solid #1B4F53 selection state, and a four-step text scale that takes body prose from 17:1 down to 11:1. Styling only — no features.

plugins.name: Parchment Theme
plugins.description: A warm parchment global theme: cream paper background with a faint grid, ink-colored user bubbles, paper assistant cards, and monospace meta lines. No features beyond styling.

plugins.name: PiOpt
plugins.description: PiOpt 是 PI-Desktop 的控制台插件：外观（界面动效的克制预设与实时预览、减弱动态保护、推理强度滑杆的吸附动效，以及可即时开关的窗口磨砂材质、背景图与 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸（video 直接播放、scene 由随插件分发的 WebWallGL 引擎渲染），以及按帧率重绘视频壁纸的性能模式）、行为（聊天框的模型浮窗始终列出全部模型，可按默认顺序 / 供应商 / 厂商 / 名称排列，选中标记可用圆角框替代对勾，推理强度滑杆的档位可译成中文，窗口入口（新建任务、搜索）可从会话标题栏搬进侧边栏）、远程（同一局域网里配对后的设备可以看会话、发指令、停止运行，电脑浏览器同样可用）与插件市场（读取官方目录，经镜像下载并按 sha256 校验），并在侧边栏左下角第二个按钮后提供一个控制台入口。

plugins.name: Prompt Enhancement
plugins.description: Rewrite the current Composer draft as a clearer prompt when you choose to run it.

plugins.name: Prompt Switcher
plugins.description: Manage local directory `.md` prompts: input or quickly select and apply them in the initial turn of a conversation (similar to `agents.md`), automatically ignoring existing chat history.

plugins.name: Scratch Calculator
plugins.description: A paper-like multi-line calculator: evaluate as you type, keep a draft history, add notes to each line, copy results or export the sheet as an image, with local draft management and dark mode.

plugins.name: Session Orchestrator
plugins.description: Coordinate durable PI-Desktop sessions with bidirectional messages, host-owned completion notifications, reliable results, and configured model selection.

plugins.name: SSH Manager
plugins.description: A local-first SSH host manager for PI-Desktop with local OpenSSH config import, identity-file selection, and bounded high-risk commands.

plugins.name: Super Domain Man
plugins.description: A local-first DNS and SSL workspace for Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare, AWS Route53, Volcano Engine and Huawei Cloud. Credentials stay on this device.

plugins.name: Terminal
plugins.description: Otty-inspired interactive terminal for PI-Desktop. Docks in the right work panel (no separate window), with tabs, cross-platform shell profiles, and copy/paste.

plugins.name: OpenCode Theme
plugins.description: Pixel-perfect port of the official OpenCode palette (anomalyco/opencode): #9d7cd8 violet headings, #7fd88f mint code, #f5a742 amber highlights, and monospace typography.

plugins.name: Theme Studio
plugins.description: PI-Desktop theme studio: 5 built-in palettes, visual editing of all 56 --ds-* tokens and 7 background regions (window, sidebar, chat, dock, titlebar, thread, composer) with fills, gradients, local PNG images, blur and radius. The preview is a faithful replica of the real window, contrast is checked live (WCAG 2.1), and image backgrounds are referenced by absolute path so saving never reloads the plugin. Also ships four Agent tools, so a theme can be created from a sentence.

plugins.name: ThinkRail
plugins.description: ThinkRail for PI-Desktop: a spec-graph the agent can read, query and maintain (7 spec_* tools), 10 workflow skills (including the authoring checklist for the family), and a panel with a specs browser.

plugins.name: Todo List
plugins.description: The official PI-Desktop todo list with list and four-quadrant layouts, due dates, native reminders and a todo_manage agent tool for querying, adding, splitting, completing and rescheduling tasks.

plugins.name: Token Insights
plugins.description: A private local dashboard for the tokens you spend across PI-Desktop, Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode: follows the app's theme and language, filters by tool, model, provider, date range or keyword, and keeps a streak and milestone worth looking at.

plugins.name: Web Access
plugins.description: Web search, page and image fetching, stored-content retrieval, source checks, page answers, field extraction, and authenticated fetches for the agent, ported from the pi-web-access extension.

plugins.name: C盘防垃圾
plugins.description: 防止模型把测试、日志、缓存、临时文件写到系统盘、桌面、下载。垃圾只待在当前项目的 Temp 或 scratch。
